+"""
+Load image bytes from a user-settable image reference without SSRF.
+
+Accepted references:
+- ``data:`` URLs (decoded in-process)
+- relative storage paths (``schema/id/file.png``), read through the storage client
+- absolute URLs under ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``, mapped to their storage path
+
+Every other URL is refused: the backend never issues an HTTP request to an
+address taken from user data.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+
+def storage_key_for(path: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the storage object key for ``path``, or None if ``path`` is not
+    in our storage."""
+    if not path or not isinstance(path, str):
+        return None
+    path = path.strip()
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if "://" in path or path.startswith("//"):
+        if not host or not path.startswith(host + "/"):
+            return None
+        key = path[len(host) + 1:]
+        key = key.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
+        key = unquote(key)
+    else:
+        if ":" in path.split("/", 1)[0]:
+            # Some other scheme (file:, gopher:, ...)
+            return None
+        key = path
+    key = key.lstrip("/")
+    if not key or "\\" in key or any(seg in ("..", ".") for seg in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def decode_data_url(url: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    try:
+        _, encoded = url.split(",", 1)
+        return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+    except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(path: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns the image bytes for ``path`` or None if it cannot (or must not)
+    be loaded."""
+    if not path or not isinstance(path, str):
+        return None
+    if path.startswith("data:"):
+        return decode_data_url(path)
+    key = storage_key_for(path)
+    if key is None:
+        print(f"[ImageLoader] Refusing to load image from untrusted URL: {path[:100]}")
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    return storage.download_image(key)

+"""Exports report the cuts they leave out: `missing.txt` in the ZIP and the
+`X-Missing-Cuts` header on both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+DATA_PNG = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+NOT_AN_IMAGE = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b"definitely not a png").decode()
+
+
+def _episode(client, h, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode with cuts numbered 1..n; None leaves a cut without an image."""
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    episode = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes", headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert episode.status_code == 200, episode.text
+    episode_id = episode.json()["id"]
+    for n, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": n, "image_path": path})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def _zip(client, h, episode_id):
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r, zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(settings.MINIO_BUCKET, {})["episodes/x/ok.png"] = PNG
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [
+        DATA_PNG,                              # 1 ok
+        None,                                  # 2 no image yet
+        "http://169.254.169.254/latest/",      # 3 refused address
+        "episodes/x/ok.png",                   # 4 ok (storage)
+        "episodes/x/gone.png",                 # 5 not in storage
+        NOT_AN_IMAGE,                          # 6 not an image
+    ])
+    r, zf = _zip(client, h, episode_id)
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,5,6"
+    assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "5", "6"]
+    assert sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith(".png")) == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_04.png"]
+
+
+def test_zip_without_missing_cuts_has_no_list_or_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [DATA_PNG, DATA_PNG])
+    r, zf = _zip(client, h, episode_id)
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+    assert len(zf.namelist()) == 2
+
+
+def test_webtoon_export_reports_missing_cuts_in_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [None, DATA_PNG, "http://127.0.0.1/admin", NOT_AN_IMAGE, "episodes/x/gone.png"])
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["content-type"] == "image/png"
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "1,3,4,5"
+
+
+def test_webtoon_export_without_missing_cuts_has_no_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [DATA_PNG, DATA_PNG])
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+
+
+def test_missing_cuts_header_is_readable_cross_origin(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [DATA_PNG, None])
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",
+        headers={**h, "Origin": "http://localhost:3000"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    exposed = [x.strip().lower() for x in r.headers["access-control-expose-headers"].split(",")]
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" in exposed

+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "getaddrinfo", refuse)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect", refuse)
